technical.summary: Strong trend structure with ADX confirmation and golden cross, but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 84.94, stoch bearish cross) and declining momentum indicators create elevated pullback risk despite bullish price structure.

fundamental.summary: MCD shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 90 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: Congressional activity is minimal and dated (106+ days old); market fear (38/100) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and neutral AAII sentiment prevent conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 287 crisis regime, FOMC event today) creates severe headwinds for discretionary consumer stocks; 90-day earnings adds execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: ADX strong trend confirmation + golden cross SMA 50/200 + new 20-day high create structural bullish setup with defined support at 249.54.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 84.94, stoch bearish cross), zero fundamental catalysts, inverted yield curve + VIX crisis regime, and FOMC event today create unacceptable risk/reward for discretionary consumer stock.

decision.entry_rationale: Not applicable — macro environment and fundamental weakness override technical strength.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis regime (287), inverted yield curve, and FOMC event today create severe macro headwinds that will likely trigger sharp pullback in discretionary consumer stocks regardless of technical setup.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
